title: Machine Unlearning in Generative AI: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the probabilities assigned to contrasting portions of sentences using the StereoSet dataset to evaluate model stereotype preferences.

Evaluating Equalized Odds (EO) across demographic groups using datasets like HateXplain, and comparing the probabilities associated with stereotyped versus non-stereotyped sentence pairs using the StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs benchmarks.
Evaluating fairness constraints such as Equalized Odds using HateXplain annotations, and measuring sentence probability differences for stereotypical content using StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs datasets.
Comparing the probabilities assigned to contrasting sentences evaluating model preferences across different professions using the StereoSet benchmark.

Measuring the extent of stereotypical biases by comparing the probabilities associated with paired sentences (one stereotyping a disadvantaged group, the other representing an advantaged group) using the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
